name: Greater Slayer
body:
You are a master of judgment in battle.

Prerequisite(s): Judgment office, slayer ability.

Benefit(s): You can focus on multiple judgments at once.

Select two judgments to gain the benefit of the slayer ability. Once a round, you can change even a slayer-focused judgment as a swift action.
